hook: Fit: High. Promotes Lexington, Buena Vista and Rockbridge outdoor recreation — TEE's core content — and runs an active event-sponsorship program (Round 12 applications were Sept 1–30, 2026).
subject: The Experience Exchange × Lexington & Rockbridge Area Tourism
message:
Hi Lexington & Rockbridge Area Tourism team,

We're W&L students who spend every weekend on Rockbridge trails and rivers, and we'd love to help more people discover the places your team works so hard to promote.

I'm Sofia Iuteri, and I run The Experience Exchange, the student outdoor adventure magazine at Washington & Lee. We cover local trails, rivers and gear for W&L students and the Lexington community, in print and on Instagram (@expowlu). Local businesses like Walkabout Outfitter and Lex Running Shop already partner with us, and we'd love to work with you too.

One idea: a sponsored 'Rockbridge Adventure Map' centerfold in each issue, plus a co-branded Instagram series on @expowlu highlighting local trails and rivers.

Would you be up for a quick chat about it? Here's the magazine so you can get a feel for us: https://theexperienceexchange.vercel.app

Thanks so much,
Sofia Iuteri
